summary: Configured node1 with a persistent HTTP service on TCP 8081 bound exclusively to 127.0.0.1. It survived the required node reboot and remains inaccessible through external address 10.100.110.10.
actions_performed: Created the web content and a hardened systemd service.
Verified HTTP 200 and expected content through 127.0.0.1:8081.
Rebooted node1 once and confirmed its boot identity changed and the service recovered.

evidence.requirement: TCP 8081 is reachable only through loopback
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, ss showed only 127.0.0.1:8081; loopback returned HTTP 200 with expected content, while 10.100.110.10:8081 refused the connection.
The service was enabled and active initially and remained enabled and active after reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID changed to 331a9791-6794-43a5-a7e6-47d829a23381; final checks proved system, service, content, loopback access, and external-interface isolation recovered.
